data_notes.market_size_variance: Multiple market research firms report different figures for AI in genomics market size due to varying scope definitions (clinical genomics only vs. research genomics vs. including AI infrastructure). Range in 2026: $1.56B (Fortune BI, clinical focus) to $2.18B (GlobeNewsWire, broader scope). Trend data uses Fortune Business Insights as primary source.
data_notes.growth_5y_calculation: 5Y growth (+351%) calculated from 2021 baseline of $346.3M (Verified Market Research via PRNewswire) to 2026 value of $1.56B (Fortune Business Insights). Cross-checked against 40.6% CAGR (Valuates Reports) which implies similar trajectory.
data_notes.growth_1y_calculation: 1Y growth (+15%) calculated from 2025 value of $1.36B to 2026 value of $1.56B per Fortune Business Insights.
data_notes.growth_3m_calculation: 3M growth (+7%) approximated from quarterly extrapolation of 29.85% annual CAGR: (1.2985)^0.25 - 1 ≈ 6.8%.
data_notes.market_share_note: Market share percentages for individual players are estimates based on publicly available revenue data and analyst commentary, not exact figures from a single source. Treated as approximate ranges.
data_notes.search_volume_note: Search volume of ~40,000/month is an estimate based on keyword research patterns for 'AI genomics' and related terms. Not sourced from a verified SEO tool due to tool limitations in this research session. [unverified]
